audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags that the page never names any of Yuumi's own abilities (Feline Friendship, Prowling Projectile, You and Me!, Zoomies, Final Chapter) — only Galio's kit is named.
audit.why: Reader needs to know which of her tools is being discussed, not just "her poke" or "her R".
audit.corrected: Added You and Me! and Prowling Projectile to breakdown.mid, and Final Chapter to breakdown.late (content layer). Full-layer cooldowns/report/dosFull already reference "You and Me!" by name and were corrected on the mechanics, not just naming.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], and report[5] all describe You and Me! as something with a "dismount window" / cooldown to punish, but the kit lists its cooldown as 0 — it never goes on cooldown.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/yuumi.json: W cooldown "0", cost "0". She can reattach instantly; the actual punish window is only the seconds she is voluntarily unattached (to poke or use Zoomies), not a timer running out.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, and report[5].t to say the dash has zero cooldown and the punish window is the unattached moment, not a cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side is already "Galio" on all 7 rows and matches content win[] (57.11% WR, 506 games, all-Galio chart) — no chart edit needed.
audit.why: Verification only; unlike other matchups on this page, this chart was not left on the "Skill" placeholder.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you keep snowballing because she brings no CC to stop your engages and your W Shield of Durand eats her attached poke. At 6 your R Hero's Entrance flanks her duo for an AoE knock-up she cannot peel, so line it up with your ADC's damage and take repeated all-ins.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you keep snowballing: her You and Me! dash has no cooldown but grants no CC, and your W Shield of Durand eats her attached Prowling Projectile poke. At 6 your R Hero's Entrance flanks her duo for an AoE knock-up she cannot peel, so line it up with your ADC damage.

edits.before: First and second items don't save Yuumi here: she has no hard CC and no peel for a diving Galio, so your Hero's Entrance keeps landing on her backline. Force flank fights over sustained poke wars and her heals can't out-pace your burst engage.
edits.after: First and second items don't save Yuumi here: she has no hard CC and no peel, and her R Final Chapter is a channel your knock-up cancels outright. Force flank fights over sustained poke wars — her heals can't out-pace your burst engage.

edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shield of Durand banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Yuumi's You and Me! has zero cooldown — she's never locked out by a timer, only caught in the seconds she's unattached. - Keep W Shield of Durand banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Untargetable while attached, and the dash has zero cooldown — she reattaches instantly, so punish the unattached moment, not a window.

edits.before: Track Yuumi’s You and Me! (Attach): Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Yuumi's You and Me!: it has zero cooldown, so there is no downtime to wait for — catch her only while unattached, or knock out her host.

notes: Yuumi's W flag data carries "hardCC" on You and Me! (Attach), which contradicts Riot's own description (a dash + untargetability, not crowd control on an enemy) — flagged here as a likely tooltip-parsing misfire per the calibration note, and not asserted anywhere in the edits.
